faqs.q: What is included in a TV mounting visit?
faqs.a: We fit the bracket, hang the television, check level and load, connect power and HDMI, and leave the room tidy. Bring your own mount, or we can advise on one that matches the screen and the wall. In-wall or external concealment and a TV outlet can be quoted on the same visit.

faqs.q: What kinds of TV mounts do you install?
faqs.a: Four common types: a fixed mount that sits close to the wall, a tilting mount that angles down, a full-motion mount that extends and swivels, and ceiling TV mounting.

faqs.q: How long does TV mounting take?
faqs.a: A straightforward living-room mount is about an hour. Fireplace work, masonry, or in-wall concealment adds time — we say so before we start.
No. The three primary services are TV mounting, electrical (fixtures, ceiling fans, outlets), and general handyman work such as furniture assembly, wall repair, painting, and hanging.

faqs.q: How is electrical or handyman work priced?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the project, scope, and materials. Send photos through the free quote form and PrimeFix will follow up with availability and pricing.
Two years on workmanship. If our fixings or workmanship fail in that time, we return and set it right.
We serve San Diego and surrounding areas in California.

legalPages.title: Privacy Policy
legalPages.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how PrimeFix Home & Handyman Services LLC (“PrimeFix,” “we,” “us”) collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit primefixpros.com, request a quote, book a service, or communicate with us. It applies to customers and prospective customers in our service area: San Diego and surrounding areas, California.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body:
PrimeFix Home & Handyman Services LLC provides home services under the names PrimeFix and PrimeFix Home & Handyman.

• Website: primefixpros.com
• Mailing address: 2108 N St, Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816, United States
• Service area: San Diego and surrounding areas, California
• Email: info@primefix.com
• Phone: (619) 736-3016

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body:
We collect information you give us through Book Now, Get a Free Quote, and other forms on this website, and information you share when you communicate with us about a job.

• Name, phone number, and email address
• Service or property address and ZIP code
• The service you request and your description of the project
• Photos you upload
• Preferred appointment date, appointment history, and service history
• Estimates, invoices, and related business records
• Messages and other communications with us
• Marketing preferences and consent records, including the phone number or email address, the date and time, the form or page, and the version of the consent text you saw
• Limited payment information processed by our payment providers
• Technical and usage information the website or our service providers may receive, such as browser type, device, and pages visited, where that information is available to us

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body:
We use personal information to respond to inquiries, prepare estimates, schedule and perform services, send appointment confirmations, reminders, scheduling messages, and service updates, process payments, keep records, and provide customer support.

We send marketing messages only when you have opted in. We also keep information as needed for legal, accounting, and recordkeeping obligations.

sections.heading: Who can access it
sections.body: Authorized PrimeFix personnel and service providers can access personal information only as needed to do their work for PrimeFix.

sections.heading: Service providers and sharing
sections.body:
We may share information with companies that help us operate, including website hosting, email delivery, text-message delivery, email lists such as Mailchimp, payment processing, analytics, scheduling or customer-record tools, and other vendors we engage. Those providers process information on our behalf and only for the services they provide to PrimeFix.

We do not sell personal information. We do not give mobile phone numbers or text-message opt-in consent to third parties for their own marketing.

sections.heading: Text messages and email
sections.body: Our Messaging Terms & Conditions describe the texts and emails we send. Marketing text messages are optional. You can request a quote or purchase a service without agreeing to them. Reply STOP to unsubscribe from marketing text messages, and reply HELP for help. You can unsubscribe from marketing email at any time.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
sections.body: We keep personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide services, keep business and transaction records, handle disputes, and meet legal and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Privacy requests
sections.body: To ask for access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, email info@primefix.com. You can also call (619) 736-3016.

sections.heading: Cookies and advertising tools
sections.body: This website does not use the Meta Pixel, Google Ads tags, or other advertising pixels, and it does not use those tools to follow you across other websites. The public pages do not set analytics or advertising cookies. A session cookie is used only for the private admin sign-in and is not used to track customers.

sections.heading: Updates
sections.body: We may update this policy by posting a new version on this page. The effective date at the top of the page will change when we do.

legalPages.title: Messaging Terms & Conditions
legalPages.intro: These terms describe text messages and emails from PrimeFix Home & Handyman Services LLC (“PrimeFix”). They apply to messages from (619) 736-3016 and info@primefix.com.

sections.heading: Who messages you
sections.body:
Messages come from PrimeFix Home & Handyman Services LLC, also called PrimeFix or PrimeFix Home & Handyman.

• Website: primefixpros.com
• Mailing address: 2108 N St, Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816, United States
• Service area: San Diego and surrounding areas, California
• Email: info@primefix.com
• Phone: (619) 736-3016

sections.heading: Types of messages
sections.body:
We send transactional messages and, if you opt in, marketing messages.

Transactional messages include quote follow-ups, appointment confirmations, appointment reminders, scheduling messages, and service updates.

Marketing messages include promotions, discounts, special offers, announcements, and occasional follow-up about our services.

sections.heading: How we send them
sections.body: We send messages by text message (SMS) and by email. Text messages are delivered by a messaging provider that sends them for PrimeFix. That provider is used only to deliver PrimeFix messages.

sections.heading: Frequency
sections.body: Message frequency varies. Marketing messages are sent from time to time. There is no fixed schedule.

sections.heading: Consent
sections.body:
Marketing text messages are optional. Agreeing to them is not required to request a quote or purchase a service. The marketing text checkbox on our forms is unchecked until you check it.

The text-message checkbox says: “I agree to receive recurring marketing and follow-up text messages from PrimeFix Home & Handyman Services LLC at the phone number provided, including messages sent using automated technology. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. See Privacy Policy and Messaging Terms & Conditions.”

The email checkbox says: “I'd like to receive occasional PrimeFix offers, service updates, and promotions by email. I can unsubscribe at any time.”

When you opt in, we keep a record of that consent: the phone number or email address, the date and time, the form or page, and the version of the consent text.

sections.heading: STOP and HELP
sections.body:
Reply STOP to unsubscribe from marketing text messages. Reply HELP and we will reply with assistance and how to reach us. You can also call (619) 736-3016 or email info@primefix.com.

To stop marketing email, use the unsubscribe option in the email or write to info@primefix.com.

sections.heading: Message and data rates
sections.body: Message and data rates may apply. Your mobile carrier can tell you about charges for text messages.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. We do not share your mobile number or text-message opt-in with third parties for their own marketing. A messaging, email, or list provider may process that information only to send messages for PrimeFix.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Our Privacy Policy explains the personal information we collect and how we use it.

googleReviews.author: Paula Izidoro
googleReviews.quote: I highly recommend Primefix Home! I initially found them on Instagram and was a bit leery at first, but I am absolutely thrilled with the service provided. Vlad did a super professional job mounting both my TV and soundbar and hiding the wires. He came fully prepared and even provided the necessary mounts. I was actually missing the safety screws needed to secure my TV, but he had them on hand and didn't charge me anything extra to use them. On top of the excellent workmanship, Vlad was very responsive and accommodating on scheduling, and the pricing was incredibly reasonable compared to other quotes I looked into. I am so happy with the final result.

googleReviews.author: Taya Harley
googleReviews.quote: I had a great experience! Vlad was great! The TV installation was done quickly and professionally, and everything was mounted perfectly with all the wires neatly hidden. Vlad made sure everything was level, working properly, and even helped set everything up before leaving. I've also used Vlad for handyman work, and the quality has always been excellent. He is reliable, knowledgeable, punctual, and pay attention to the details. Definitely recommend Vlad!!!

googleReviews.author: Josue david Perez rocha
googleReviews.quote: I recently hired this handyman to mount my TV on the wall, and he did an outstanding job! The installation looks clean and professional, and I'm now really happy and content with how everything turned out. The price was very good, and his punctuality and overall professionalism were top notch. He showed up on time, worked efficiently, and left the space neat. Highly recommend him I'll definitely be calling again for future projects! Thank you Vlad!

googleReviews.author: charles money
googleReviews.quote: Unbelievable guest service!!! I've dealt with a lot of insulation people in the past since I like to have 3D art on the walls and most of them have been extremely difficult with working with what my vision is. However they had no problem at all prime fix is literally one of my favorite handyman now!! I won't go to anybody else in the future they knew exactly what I wanted dealt with my crazy personality and my vision for my layout and had no problem working around my art!!! Truly an amazing experience.

googleReviews.author: silvia duran
googleReviews.quote: Vlad was amazing—very respectful and super helpful. He mounted my 85-inch TV, hid the wires perfectly, and put together my 80-inch TV stand with a fireplace. Everything looks beautiful, and I couldn't be happier. Highly recommend!

googleReviews.author: Regina Lynn
googleReviews.quote: Vlad installed and mounted my 50” Samsung The Frame TV in my guest bedroom. A few months ago he mounted my 55” The Frame TV above my fireplace, in my living room. He is prompt, professional and very kind. I loved that I didn’t have to wait several days to receive service. I look forward to working with him on my other home projects in the future.

googleReviews.author: Maksym Husiev
googleReviews.quote: I am beyond happy with the installation of my new projector and screen. I wanted to leave a glowing review for the technician who did the work. I was honestly amazed that he handled the entire installation-a large screen and the projector setup-all by himself. His professionalism, skill, and attention to detail were incredible to watch. He was efficient, careful, and made sure everything was perfect. The final result is flawless. The screen is perfectly aligned, the setup is clean, and my new home theater looks absolutely amazing.

googleReviews.author: Brian VanDeMark
googleReviews.quote: Through hard work and craftsmanship, Vlad miraculously transformed a worn-out storage area in my basement into a splendid and sparkling home library for my book collection—performing professionally, responsively, and courteously throughout. Bravo Vlad!
